title: A street address and zip code read with pauses between the parts

items.speaker: agent
items.text: Thanks for calling. What can I help you with today?

items.speaker: caller
items.text: Hi, I've moved recently and I need to update the address you have for me.

items.speaker: agent
items.text: No problem. Give me the new address one part at a time, starting with the street.

items.speaker: caller
items.text: It's twelve forty <1.3s> Maple Avenue, <1.5s> apartment three B.

items.speaker: agent
items.text: Twelve forty Maple Avenue, apartment three B. And the city and zip code?

items.speaker: caller
items.text: Springfield, <1.2s> zip code <1.4s> six two seven <1.1s> zero four.

items.speaker: agent
items.text: Springfield, six two seven zero four. The new address is saved, and anything we post will go there from now on. Is there anything else?
